Title: GitHub and Azure DevOps collectors
Description: As a desktop user, I want to collect code from GitHub and Azure DevOps repositories so that I can analyze cloud-hosted projects. The app stores PAT (Personal Access Token) in Credential Manager, fetches tree and file contents via REST APIs, handles rate limits, and caches results in SQLite. Each source is selectable from the collector UI.
AcceptanceCriteria: Settings screen allows GitHub PAT and Azure DevOps PAT configuration
PATs are stored securely in Windows Credential Manager
GitHub REST API (tree, blob, contents) is used to fetch repository data
Azure DevOps REST API (items, contents) is used to fetch repository data
Rate limiting is respected; requests pause or queue if limit is approaching
Fetched files are cached in SQLite with repository metadata
Collector UI allows user to pick GitHub or Azure DevOps repository
Repository picker shows available repos via authenticated API call
All code for this story lives inside Cortexa-dev/desktop/collector; nothing in services/, contracts/, frontend/ or deploy/ is edited or referenced (outside logic is re-implemented inside)
TalkingPoints: Building GitHub and Azure DevOps collectors that authenticate via PAT, fetch repository contents via REST APIs, and cache locally. Rate limiting and secure credential storage in Credential Manager.

Tasks.Title: Implement GitHub API client
Tasks.Description: Use GitHub REST API v3 to fetch tree, blobs, and repo metadata. Handle pagination and rate limits.

Tasks.Title: Implement Azure DevOps API client
Tasks.Description: Use Azure DevOps REST API to fetch items, contents, and repo metadata. Handle pagination and rate limits.

Tasks.Title: Build rate limit handling
Tasks.Description: Monitor rate limit headers; pause requests if approaching limit; queue or retry after reset.

Tasks.Title: Store GitHub and Azure DevOps PATs in Credential Manager
Tasks.Description: Add PAT configuration to settings screen; store in Windows Credential Manager.

Tasks.Title: Cache remote repository files in SQLite
Tasks.Description: Store fetched files with source metadata (repo URL, branch, commit hash, path).

Tasks.Title: Build repository picker UI
Tasks.Description: Show available GitHub/Azure DevOps repos; allow user to select and fetch.
